_comment: The invitations the paper carries. raceType: DragRace, Circuit or Sprint. schedule: OneTime, Daily, Weekly or
Permanent (always on offer). entryRequirements is a car filter, left out for any car:
{ "type": "origin", "origin": "USA" }            a country, or American, European, Japanese...
{ "type": "years", "startYear": 1950, "endYear": 1959 }   either end may be left out
{ "type": "power", "minHP": 300, "maxHP": 500 }  either end may be left out
{ "type": "value", "minValue": 1000, "maxValue": 5000 }   what the car is worth, either end
{ "type": "all", "filters": [ ... ] }            every one of them; "any" for one of them
requiredMilestones are milestone ids. reward.specialItem is "rare_camshaft" (the best camshaft that fits the
winner's engine) or "part:<part id>" (that part, on the shelf).
